name: admin-splash-switch
description: Admin panel -> Config -> 'Post view splash': verify the GLOBAL switch (server/core/inlineSplash.ts) flips what every player sees in the post view, persists to redis (read back over /api/trpc/config.getInlineSplash), mirrors into the local cache for synchronous first paint, warns when a device override is masking it, and resets to the shipped default. Runs as u/bob (admin) - the DBG console and admin panel are admin-gated.

steps._comment: DBG + admin panel are admin-only; whoever ran last may not be an admin (carol is not).
DBG toggle is admin-gated (App.jsx gates on isAdmin) - run as an admin user e.g. bob

steps.name: pre-clean: drop any device override left by the `splash` debug command

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) throw new Error('no debug input'); if (el.value !== 'admin') { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()
steps.name: press Enter on 'admin'

steps._comment: Config tab hosts both the server feature flags and the global splash switch
ASSERT: switch renders. It sits ABOVE the flags block and is rendered in both ConfigPanel branches, so it must appear even if the flag fetch fails.
The switch loads its own state from admin.getInlineSplash; splash-source only exists after that query lands (before it, the panel shows 'loading splash setting...').

steps.expression: JSON.stringify({ source: document.querySelector('[data-testid=splash-source]')?.textContent.trim(), court: document.querySelector('[data-testid=splash-state-court]')?.dataset.on, classic: document.querySelector('[data-testid=splash-state-classic]')?.dataset.on, globalCache: window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash_global'), deviceOverride: window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash') })
steps.name: baseline (LIVE variant + cache state before any change)

steps._comment: Show the original galaxy splash to EVERYONE
ASSERT: classic went LIVE. Times out (= failure) if the mutation did not take.
ASSERT: court went off - the two are mutually exclusive, not both-on

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash_global'); if (v !== 'classic') throw new Error('global not mirrored into local cache: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); return 'cached=' + v; })()
steps.name: ASSERT global mirrored locally (this is what the feed paints synchronously)

steps.expression: (() => { window.__splashProbe = window.__splashProbe || {}; window.__splashProbe['afterSet'] = 'pending'; fetch('/api/trpc/config.getInlineSplash', { method: 'GET' }).then(async (r) => { window.__splashProbe['afterSet'] = r.status + ' :: ' + (await r.text()); }).catch((e) => { window.__splashProbe['afterSet'] = 'THREW ' + e.message; }); return 'fired'; })()
steps.name: fire server read-back (afterSet)
steps._comment: Async eval RETURN VALUES come back as {} in this runner, so a throw inside an async fn is invisible and the assertion would silently pass. Stash on window, sleep, then assert in a SYNC eval below.

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.__splashProbe && window.__splashProbe['afterSet']; if (!v || v === 'pending') throw new Error('probe did not resolve: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); if (!/^200 /.test(v)) throw new Error('bad status: ' + v.slice(0, 200)); if (!/classic/.test(v)) throw new Error('server does not report classic: ' + v.slice(0, 300)); return 'server says: ' + v.slice(0, 160); })()
steps.name: ASSERT redis holds it - a cold client (any other player) resolves classic

steps.expression: (() => { window.localStorage.setItem('fw_inline_splash', 'court'); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fw-inline-splash-change')); return 'device override set to court while global=classic'; })()
steps.name: simulate the trap: a leftover `splash` debug override on the admin's own device

steps._comment: ASSERT: the panel says out loud that THIS device is showing something other than the global setting - the 'I flipped it and nothing happened' case.
ASSERT: the LIVE badge still tracks the SERVER value, not the local override. The two layers must not be conflated.
'Clear local override' - only rendered while an override exists

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash'); if (v !== null) throw new Error('device override not cleared: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid=splash-mask-warning]')) throw new Error('warning still shown after clearing override'); return 'override cleared, warning gone'; })()
steps.name: ASSERT clearing the local override removes it and the warning

steps._comment: Clears the GLOBAL override so everyone follows DEFAULT_SPLASH again - also leaves redis clean for later tests
ASSERT: back to DEFAULT_SPLASH ('court') for everyone.

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash_global'); if (v !== null) throw new Error('global cache not cleared: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); return 'cache cleared - device follows build default again'; })()
steps.name: ASSERT local cache cleared when the global override is removed

steps.expression: (() => { window.__splashProbe = window.__splashProbe || {}; window.__splashProbe['afterClear'] = 'pending'; fetch('/api/trpc/config.getInlineSplash', { method: 'GET' }).then(async (r) => { window.__splashProbe['afterClear'] = r.status + ' :: ' + (await r.text()); }).catch((e) => { window.__splashProbe['afterClear'] = 'THREW ' + e.message; }); return 'fired'; })()
steps.name: fire server read-back (afterClear)
steps._comment: Async eval RETURN VALUES come back as {} in this runner, so a throw inside an async fn is invisible and the assertion would silently pass. Stash on window, sleep, then assert in a SYNC eval below.

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.__splashProbe && window.__splashProbe['afterClear']; if (!v || v === 'pending') throw new Error('probe did not resolve: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); if (!/^200 /.test(v)) throw new Error('bad status: ' + v.slice(0, 200)); if (/classic/.test(v)) throw new Error('server STILL reports classic: ' + v.slice(0, 300)); return 'server says: ' + v.slice(0, 160); })()
steps.name: ASSERT redis override removed (teardown verified, not assumed)
